title: Evidence pack (team artifact)
description: A game-evidence-v1 pack for one build, as described in spec/TEMPLATE_SPEC.md#live-evidence. This schema covers the manifest that points to it; the pack itself follows the template's engine contract. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).

version.description: Artifact schema version the producer wrote. Same major as x-version.

id.description: Template id, or owner for files the owner makes.

createdAt.description: UTC time the file was written.

synthetic.description: True for worked examples. Consumers never treat synthetic data as a measurement.

build.description: The build the items describe, when they describe one.

path.description: Relative path of the pack JSON inside .grokbot-team/artifacts/evidence-pack/.

templates.description: Template ids the pack was captured for.
